_comment: Context for translators. Keys must match en.json. Tone: plain, short, no ERP jargon (design system README, Content).
appTeacher: App name shown under the logo and on the home screen. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
appStaff: App name for non-teaching staff (office, lab assistants, support).
appParent: App name for parents and students.
appPlatform: Name of the platform administration site (for the SaaS owner).
appWebsite: Title of the public website (browser tab). The tagline 'Schools. People. Progress.' is fixed brand copy: translate it only with approval (brand guidelines).
scaffoldNotice: Temporary placeholder text on unfinished screens. Not shown to schools in production.
greetingMorning: Home screen greeting before 12:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingAfternoon: Home screen greeting 12:00-17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingEvening: Home screen greeting after 17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
actionUploadNow: Button that sends saved offline work immediately.
actionTakeAttendance: Primary button on the teacher home screen.
actionMarkAllPresent: Button that marks every student present; the teacher then changes only the exceptions.
actionSubmitAttendance: Primary button that submits the class attendance.
syncSynced: Sync status: all work is on the server.
syncSavedOnDevice: Sync status: work is saved on this phone and will upload when online.
syncChangesPending: Sync status: number of changes waiting to upload. Use the language's correct plural forms.
syncFailed: Sync status: the upload did not work.
statusLate: Attendance status: arrived after the bell.
statusMedical: Attendance status: absent for a medical reason.
statusHalfDay: Attendance status: present for half the day.
errorServerUnreachable: Error message. Reassures the user that nothing is lost; never blames them.
saasSignInTitle: Heading of the platform owner's sign-in screen.
saasSignInIntro: One line under the sign-in heading. Schools sign in elsewhere.
authEmailLabel: Label of the email field on sign-in.
authPasswordLabel: Label of the password field on sign-in.
actionSignIn: Button that signs a person in.
actionSignInGoogle: Button for Google sign-in. Keep the word Google in Latin letters.
actionSignInPhone: Link that switches sign-in to a one-time code sent by SMS.
actionSignInEmail: Link that switches sign-in back to email and password.
authPhoneLabel: Label of the phone number field.
authPhoneHint: Hint under the phone field. Keep the example number as it is.
actionSendCode: Button that sends a one-time code by SMS.
authCodeLabel: Label of the field where the SMS code is typed.
actionVerifyCode: Button that checks the SMS code.
authOr: Small word between two sign-in options.
actionSignOut: Button that signs the person out.
authSigningIn: Shown on the button while sign-in is in progress.
authErrorCredentials: Error after a wrong email or password. Do not say which one is wrong.
authErrorTooMany: Error when sign-in is temporarily blocked.
authErrorNetwork: Error when the device is offline during sign-in.
authErrorPopupClosed: Error when the person closes the Google sign-in window.
authErrorCode: Error after a wrong or expired SMS code.
authErrorPhone: Error for a phone number that is not valid.
saasNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not the platform owner.
saasNoAccessBody: Explains the previous heading and what to do.
saasNavLabel: Screen reader name of the side navigation.
saasNavSchools: Side navigation item for the list of schools.
saasSchoolsCount: Number of schools under the heading.
saasSchoolsEmptyTitle: Empty state heading on the schools screen.
actionCreateSchool: Button that opens the create school form and submits it.
saasSchoolCreateTitle: Heading of the create school form.
saasSchoolName: Label of the school name field.
saasSchoolSubdomain: Label of the school's web address field (its subdomain).
saasSchoolSubdomainHint: Hint under the web address field. Keep the example as it is.
saasSchoolLanguage: Label of the school's default language choice.
actionEdit: Button that opens a form to change something.
saasSchoolEditTitle: Heading of the edit school form.
actionReactivate: Button that reactivates a suspended school.
saasSuspendTitle: Heading of the suspend confirmation. {name} is the school name.
saasSuspendReason: Label of the optional reason for suspending.
statusActive: Status of a school that is running.
statusSuspended: Status of a school that is suspended.
saasLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the list fails to load.
actionLoadMore: Button that loads the next page of a list.
errorAuthRequired: Error when the session has ended.
errorForbidden: Error when the action is not allowed.
errorNotFound: Error when something no longer exists.
errorInvalidRequest: Error when the server rejects the form.
errorConflict: Error when a name or web address is already taken.
errorRateLimited: Error when the person is sending requests too fast.
errorUpstream: Error when a back-end service is unavailable.
errorNetwork: Error when the device is offline.
errorTimeout: Error when a request times out.
statusLoading: Shown while a screen or list is loading.
actionAddAdmin: Button that adds the first administrator of a school.
saasAdminTitle: Heading of the form that adds a school's first administrator. {name} is the school name.
saasAdminIntro: Explains the add administrator form: the person sets their own password, and only the first administrator is added by the platform owner.
saasAdminName: Label of the administrator's name field.
saasAdminAdded: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in with email. {email} is their address.
saasAdminAddedNoEmail: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in by phone code only.
saasAdminEmailFailed: Warning when the account was created but the password email failed. Keep the quoted button name the same as the 'Forgot password?' text.
saasAdminExists: Error when the platform owner tries to add a second first-administrator.
errorAccountExists: Error when an email or phone number already has an account.
authForgot: Link on sign-in that sends an email to set a new password.
authResetSent: Shown after asking for a password email. Does not reveal whether the address has an account.
authResetNeedsEmail: Shown when 'Forgot password?' is pressed with the email field empty.
saasHasAdmin: Badge on a school that already has an administrator.
saasNoAdmin: Badge on a school that has no administrator yet, so nobody can sign in to it.
webSignInTitle: Heading of a school's sign-in screen. {name} is the school's name.
webSignInIntro: One line under the school sign-in heading.
webSchoolNotFoundTitle: Heading when the web address does not belong to an active school.
webNoSchoolTitle: Heading when the app is opened without a school's own web address.
webNoSchoolBody: Explains that people reach the app at their school's own address. Keep the example as it is.
webNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not a member of this school. {name} is the school's name.
webNoAccessBody: Explains what to do about no access.
webLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the person's account details fail to load after sign-in.
webNavLabel: Screen reader name of the school's side navigation.
webComingTitle: Heading shown for a navigation item whose screen is not built yet.
webYourRole: Line on the dashboard that names the person's role in the school. {role} is the role name.
errorPageTitle: Heading of the page-level error screen.
actionTryAgain: Button that retries after an error.

roleManagement: Name of a role a person has in a school.

roleSystemAdmin: Name of a role a person has in a school.

roleAccountant: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleAdmissionsOfficer: Name of a role a person has in a school.

roleDriver: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleParent: Name of a role a person has in a school.
errorUploadInvalid: Error when the chosen picture is not an accepted type or is too big.
errorUploadFailed: Error when sending a file to storage failed.
receiptTitle: Title at the top of a printed fee receipt.
receiptNumber: Label before the receipt number on a fee receipt.
receiptDate: Label before the date the fee was paid, on a fee receipt.
receiptStudent: Label before the student name on a fee receipt.
receiptEnrollment: Label before the student enrolment number on a fee receipt.
receiptClass: Label before the class (for example 5 B) on a fee receipt.
receiptFor: Label before what the payment was for (for example Tuition - April) on a fee receipt.
receiptAmountPaid: Label before the amount paid, on a fee receipt.
receiptMethod: Label before how the fee was paid (cash, cheque, UPI), on a fee receipt.
receiptReference: Label before the cheque, bank or UPI reference, on a fee receipt.
receiptBalance: Label before the amount still owed on the invoice after this payment, on a fee receipt.
receiptReceivedBy: Label before the name of the person who took the payment, on a fee receipt.
receiptCancelled: Large stamp across a fee receipt whose payment was reversed. Keep it short.
receiptFooter: Line at the bottom of a printed fee receipt.
paymentMethodCash: Way of paying a fee: cash.
paymentMethodCheque: Way of paying a fee: by cheque.
paymentMethodBankTransfer: Way of paying a fee: by bank transfer.
paymentMethodUpi: Way of paying a fee: by UPI (the Indian instant payment system).
paymentMethodOther: Way of paying a fee: any other way.
payslipTitle: Title at the top of a printed payslip.
payslipPeriod: Label before the month a payslip is for, for example 04/2027. (A month of pay, not a class period.)
payslipEmployee: Label before the name of the member of staff on a payslip.
payslipEmployeeId: Label before the employee number on a payslip.
payslipDepartment: Label before the department (for example Science) on a payslip.
payslipDesignation: Label before the job title (for example Teacher) on a payslip.
payslipEarnings: Heading of the list of pay components (basic pay, allowances) on a payslip.
payslipDeductions: Heading of the list of amounts taken off pay on a payslip.
payslipGross: Label before pay before deductions, on a payslip.
payslipTotalDeductions: Label before the sum of all deductions, on a payslip.
payslipNetPay: Label before the amount actually paid out, on a payslip. Keep it short.
payslipPaidOn: Label before the day the salary was paid, on a payslip.
payslipFooter: Line at the bottom of a printed payslip.
reportCollectionsTitle: Title of the printed fee collections report (money taken in a date range).
reportDuesTitle: Title of the printed report of unpaid fee invoices that have fallen due.
reportPayrollTitle: Title of the printed report of a year's approved and paid pay runs.
reportAsOf: Label before the date a report is calculated up to (for example As of 24-10-2026).
reportYear: Label before a calendar year on the payroll summary.
reportStatus: Column heading: the state of a payment or a pay run.
reportReversed: Status of a payment that was taken back.
reportTotal: Label of the last row, which adds up the columns above it.
ntBell: Name of the bell button in the top bar that opens the notifications.
ntBellUnread: Said after the word Notifications on the bell button when some are unread: how many.
ntEmpty: Shown when the inbox is empty.
ntMarkAll: Button: mark every notification as read.
ntSettings: Heading of the choice of which kinds of notification to show.
ntSettingsHint: Explains the choice of which kinds of notification to show.
ntCatleave: Kind of notification: about leave requests and decisions.
ntCatsubstitution: Kind of notification: about covering lessons.
ntUnread: Screen reader word before an unread notification.
ntLoadFailed: Shown in the panel when loading failed.
sbPeriod: Column heading: the period of the school day.
lvViewLabel: Screen reader label of the switch between leave requests and leave types.
lvTabTypes: Tab: the kinds of leave and what each person may take.
lvStatus: Label of the status filter and column.
lvStatusPENDING: Leave request status: waiting for the Principal.
lvStatusAPPROVED: Leave request status: the Principal agreed.
lvStatusREJECTED: Leave request status: the Principal did not agree.
lvStatusCANCELLED: Leave request status: the person withdrew it.
lvPerson: Column heading: who asked for leave.
lvType: Column heading: the kind of leave.
lvDates: Column heading: the days of the leave.
lvDecision: Column heading: who decided and when.
lvHalfMORNING: A half day of leave: the morning.
lvHalfAFTERNOON: A half day of leave: the afternoon.
lvNoRequests: Shown when no leave request matches.
lvApprove: Button: the Principal agrees to a leave request.
lvReject: Button: the Principal does not agree to a leave request.
lvRejectQuestion: Question before a leave request is rejected.
lvRejectNote: Label of the optional reason given when rejecting.
lvApproved: Confirmation after a request was approved.
lvRejected: Confirmation after a request was rejected.
lvNotPending: Refusal: the request is no longer waiting.
lvOverBalance: Refusal: the leave is more than the person may still take.
lvOverlap: Refusal: the leave overlaps another request.
lvTypeName: Label of a leave type's name.
lvPaid: Leave type: the person is paid and the days come from a yearly allowance.
lvUnpaid: Leave type: no pay; it proposes a deduction in payroll.
lvQuota: Column and field: the yearly allowance of a paid leave type.
lvAddType: Button and heading: add a kind of leave.
lvTypeAdded: Confirmation after a leave type was added.
lvIsPaid: Checkbox: the leave type is paid.
lvNoTypes: Shown when the school has no leave types.
lvTypeInUse: Refusal: a leave type with requests cannot be removed.
lvPaidNeedsQuota: Refusal: a paid type was given no yearly days.
lvAllowances: Heading of what each person may take in a year.
lvPickPerson: Label of the choice of person.
lvAllowed: Column heading: the days a person may take in the year.
lvRemaining: Column heading: the days a person may still take.
lvAllowedFor: Label of the field where HR sets a person's yearly days for a type.
lvAllowanceSaved: Confirmation after an allowance was changed.
lvBelowTaken: Refusal: the allowance is below what was taken.
lvStandardHint: Shown beside an allowance the person has not used yet.
sbFrom: Label of the first date of the range.
sbTo: Label of the last date of the range.
sbAway: Column heading: the teacher who is on leave.
sbCover: Column heading: who covers the lesson.
sbNotChosen: Shown when nobody was chosen to cover a lesson.
sbChoose: Button: choose who covers a lesson.
sbRemoveCover: Button: take the cover away from a lesson.
sbSuggestionsTitle: Heading of the list of teachers who are free and qualified for a lesson.
sbThisMonth: How many times a teacher covered lessons this month.
sbAssign: Button: choose this teacher to cover the lesson.
sbNoCandidates: Shown when no teacher can cover the lesson.
sbAssigned: Confirmation after a cover was chosen.
sbCleared: Confirmation after a cover was removed.
sbNoNeeds: Shown when approved leave leaves no lesson uncovered in the range.
sbHasOwnLesson: Refusal: the chosen teacher teaches another class then.
sbOnLeave: Refusal: the chosen teacher is on leave.
sbAlreadyCovering: Refusal: the chosen teacher covers another lesson then.
sbSameAsAbsent: Refusal: the absent teacher was chosen.
sbNoLongerNeeded: Refusal: the leave behind the need was changed.
sbChanged: Refusal: the lesson or the teacher changed while choosing.
plTitle: Heading of the proposals for unpaid leave in a pay run.
plNote: Explains the proposals for unpaid leave in a pay run.
plDays: Column heading: unpaid days inside the month.
plProposed: Column heading: the proposed pay deduction.
plApply: Button: put the proposal on the payslip as a deduction.
plAmount: Label of the field where HR may change the proposed amount.
plApplied: Shown when the deduction is already on the payslip.
plDone: Confirmation after the deduction was put on the payslip.
plNone: Shown when there is nothing to propose.
plWithout: Lists people with unpaid leave who have no payslip in the pay run.
plAlready: Refusal: the deduction is already on the payslip.
plAboveGross: Refusal: the amount is above the monthly pay.
plNotDraft: Refusal: the run is no longer a draft.
gbViewLabel: Screen reader label of the switch between marks entry, exams and terms, grade bands and report cards.
gbTabMarks: Tab: enter the marks of one exam.
gbTabExams: Tab: the school's terms and exams.
gbTabBands: Tab: the school's own grade bands, for example 90 to 100 is A1.
gbTabCards: Tab: a student's report card for a term.
gbPickTerm: Label of the choice of term.
gbPickExam: Label of the choice of exam.
gbNoTermsTitle: Title shown when the school has no terms.

gbOutOf: Under the exam name: the most marks that can be got.
gbMarksFor: Screen reader label of a student's marks field.
gbAbsentFor: Screen reader label of a student's absent checkbox.

gbNotAMark: Refusal: a mark was not a number with at most one decimal.
gbAbsentNoMarks: Refusal: absent was ticked and marks were also typed.
gbAddTerm: Button and heading: add a term to the academic year.
gbTermName: Label of the term name field.
gbTermAdded: Confirmation after a term was added.
gbNameTaken: Refusal: a term or exam name is taken.
gbTermHasExams: Refusal: a term with exams cannot be removed.
gbAddExam: Button and heading: add an exam.
gbExamName: Label of the exam name field.
gbExamAdded: Confirmation after an exam was added.
gbExamHasMarks: Refusal: an exam with marks cannot be removed.
gbBelowMark: Refusal: the exam's maximum was lowered below a mark.
gbMarksField: Label of the field for the most marks of an exam.
gbBandsNone: Shown when the school has set no grade bands.
gbFrom: Label of the lowest percentage of a band.
gbTo: Label of the highest percentage of a band.
gbAddBand: Button: add a row to the grade bands.
gbUseStandard: Button: fill the editor with the standard starting grade bands.
gbBandsSaved: Confirmation after the bands were saved.
gbRemoveBand: Screen reader label of the remove button of a band.
gbBandStart: Refusal: the lowest band does not start at 0.
gbBandEnd: Refusal: the highest band does not end at 100.
gbBandLabelTaken: Refusal: two bands share a grade.
gbBandBad: Refusal: a band is not valid.
gbPickStudent: Label of the choice of student.
gbPending: Under a report card: exams without a mark are not counted.
gbPdf: Button: download the report card as a PDF.
gbNoCard: Shown when the student was in no class that term.
gbMarkAbsent: Shown in a report card line for an exam the student missed.
attLockDone: Confirmation after a day was locked.
attViewLabel: Screen reader label of the switch between the daily register, the classes not taken yet and the status names.
attTabRegister: Tab: one class's attendance on one date.
attTabMissing: Tab: the classes that have not taken attendance on a date.
attTabNames: Tab: the school's own wording for the seven attendance statuses.
attStatusLATE: Attendance status: came after the start.
attStatusLEAVE: Attendance status: away on approved leave.
attStatusMEDICAL: Attendance status: away for a medical reason.
attStatusHALF_DAY: Attendance status: came for half the day.
attStatusEXCUSED: Attendance status: away with the school's permission.
attCount: One count in the summary line above the register: the status word and how many students.
attNotTaken: Shown when no attendance exists yet for the class and date.
attLocked: Badge: the day is locked, a teacher can no longer change it.
attLockedNote: Shown on a locked day for the Academic administrator.
attNote: Column heading and field: a short note on an exception.
attNoStudents: Shown when the class has no students.
attSaveCorrection: Button: save a correction to a locked day.
attLock: Button: lock the register so a teacher can no longer change it.
attSaved: Confirmation after the register was saved.
attCorrected: Confirmation after a correction was saved.
attDayLocked: Refusal: a teacher tried to change a locked day.
attFutureDate: Refusal: attendance cannot be taken for a future date.
attMissingEmpty: Shown when every class has taken attendance (or the school does not work on the date).
attMissingTitle: Heading of the list of classes that have not taken attendance.
attNameFor: Label of the field where a school types its own word for a status.

notifLeaveRequestedTitle: Title of the notice to the Principal that a leave request is waiting.
notifLeaveRequestedBody: Body of the notice to the Principal: who asked for how many days of which kind of leave, and when.

gradesTerm: Label before the name of the school term on a printed report card.
gradesSubject: Column heading: the subject on a report card.
gradesMarks: Column heading: the marks a student got.
gradesOutOf: Column heading: the most marks that could be got.
gradesPercent: Column heading: marks as a percentage of the most possible.
gradesGrade: Column heading: the grade band the percentage falls in.

reportDaysOverdue: Column heading: how many days past its due date an invoice is.

webTo: Label of the last date of a date range on a report screen.

webBandDueToday: Age group: falls due on the report date.

webNoDuesTitle: Empty state of the outstanding fees report: everything due is paid.
webTotalsOnly: Note shown to a role that may see report totals but not the people in them.
webPrevious: Button: go to the previous page of a table.
webNext: Button: go to the next page of a table.
webPageOf: Where you are in a table that has several pages.
webCollected: Label of the total of fee money taken in the chosen dates.
peoSearch: Placeholder-style label of the search box above a list of students.
peoAll: Choice that shows every status in a list.
peoInactive: Status of a student who is not attending at the moment.
peoLeft: Status of a student who has left the school.
peoAddStudent: Button that opens the form to add a student.
peoAddress: Form label for a home address.
peoClass: Heading of a column or form field: the class a student is in.
peoNoStudentsTitle: Empty state of the students list.
peoNoStudentsBody: Hint under the empty state of the students list.
peoNoMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing.
peoGuardians: Heading of the list of a student's guardians.
peoNoGuardians: Shown when a student has no guardian on record.
peoRelationship: Form label: how a guardian is related to the child.
peoGuardianRel: Relationship choice: a guardian who is not a parent.
peoPrimary: Marks the guardian the school calls first.
peoClassHistory: Heading of the list of classes a student has been in.
peoAdmissionDate: Label of the day a student was admitted.
peoBackToList: Link back from a detail page to its list.
peoCapacity: Column heading: how many students a class can hold.
peoSection: Column heading: the section letter of a class.
peoLevel: Column heading: the class level, for example 5 or Nursery.
peoNoClassesTitle: Empty state of the classes list.
peoApplications: Title of the admissions applications screen.
peoNewApplication: Button that opens the form for a new admission application.
peoApplicationNo: Column heading: the number given to an application.
peoLevelApplied: Form label: the class level the child is applying to.
peoSubmitted: Status of an application that has just come in.
peoUnderReview: Status of an application being looked at.
peoAccepted: Status of an application the school has accepted.
peoRejected: Status of an application the school has turned down.
peoWithdrawn: Status of an application the family took back.
peoAdmitted: Status of an application whose child is now a student.
peoStartReview: Button: move an application to under review.
peoWithdraw: Button: record that the family withdrew the application.
peoNote: Form label for a note that goes with a decision.
peoAdmitStudent: Button: turn an accepted application into a student.
peoStudentAdmitted: Confirmation after admitting a student; {id} is the new enrolment number.
peoNoApplicationsTitle: Empty state of the applications list.
hrpAddStaff: Button that opens the form to add a staff member.
hrpSearch: Label of the search box above the staff list.
hrpAllDepartments: Choice that shows staff of every department.
hrpJoined: Label of the day a staff member joined.
hrpNoStaffTitle: Empty state of the staff list.
hrpNoMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing.
hrpStaffAdded: Confirmation after adding a staff member.
hrpSalary: Heading of the salary section on a staff member's page.
hrpEarning: Kind of salary line: money the person is paid.
hrpDeduction: Kind of salary line: money taken off pay.
hrpComponent: Form label: the name of a salary line, for example Basic pay.
hrpAmount: Column heading and form label for an amount of money.
hrpAddLine: Button that adds a line to a salary.
hrpNoLines: Shown when a staff member has no salary lines.
hrpRemove: Button that removes a salary line.
hrpNewRun: Button that starts the monthly pay run.
hrpRunCreated: Confirmation after creating a pay run.
hrpDraft: Status of a pay run that can still change.
hrpPreparedBy: Label: who made the pay run.
hrpApprovedBy: Label: who approved the pay run.
hrpApprove: Button: the Principal approves a pay run.
hrpPay: Button: the Bursar records that a pay run was paid.
hrpDeleteRun: Button that deletes a draft pay run.
hrpConfirm: Button that confirms an action that cannot be undone.
hrpConfirmApprove: Question before a pay run is approved.
hrpConfirmPay: Question before a pay run is marked as paid.
hrpConfirmDelete: Question before a draft pay run is deleted.
hrpRunTitle: Title of one month's pay run page.
hrpDetails: Opens the lines of one payslip.
hrpPayslipPdf: Button that saves one payslip as a PDF.
hrpNoRunsTitle: Empty state of the pay runs list.
hrpNoRunsBody: Hint under the empty state of the pay runs list.
feeTabInvoices: Tab: the list of fee invoices.
feeTabReceipts: Tab: the list of fee receipts.
feeTabStructures: Tab: what each class level pays.
feeStatusOverdue: Status of an invoice past its due date and not paid.
feeStatusPartial: Status of an invoice that has been paid in part.
feeStatusPending: Status of an invoice that has no payment yet.
feeBilled: Total of the invoices in a list.
feeNewInvoice: Button that opens the form for a one-off invoice.
feeBillFees: Button that opens the form that makes invoices from the fee structures.
feeDescription: Form label: what an invoice is for.
feeFindStudent: Label of the box that finds the student an invoice is for.
feeRecordPayment: Button that records money received for an invoice.
feePaymentRecorded: Confirmation after a payment; {number} is the receipt number.
feePayments: Heading of the payments made against an invoice.
feeNoPayments: Shown when an invoice has no payment.
feeMethod: Form label: cash, cheque, UPI and so on.
feeReverse: Button that takes a payment back.
feeReason: Form label: why a payment is being reversed.
feeConfirmReverse: Question before a payment is reversed.
feeReceiptPdf: Button that saves a receipt as a PDF.
feeBillUpTo: Form label: the last due date to bill.
feePreview: Button that counts what would be billed without saving anything.
feeCreateInvoices: Button that makes the invoices after a preview.
feePreviewResult: Result of a preview of billing.
feeLevelAll: Choice that bills every class level.
feeReceiptsTotal: Total of the receipts in a list.
feeNoReceiptsTitle: Empty state of the receipts list.
feeNoInvoicesTitle: Empty state of the invoices list.
feeNoInvoicesBody: Hint under the empty state of the invoices list.
feeNewStructure: Button that starts the fee structure of a class level.
feeStructureCreated: Confirmation after creating a fee structure.
feeAddFee: Button that adds a fee, for example Tuition, to a structure.
feeFeeName: Form label: the name of a fee, for example Tuition.
feeInstalments: Heading of the parts a fee is paid in.
feeInstalmentLabel: Form label: the name of an instalment, for example Term 1.
feeAddInstalment: Button that adds a row for another instalment.
feeNoStructuresTitle: Empty state of the fee structures list.
feeStructureTotal: Total of all the fees of a structure.
feeNoItems: Shown when a structure has no fees.
setTabClasses: Tab: the classes of the school.
setAddClass: Button that opens the form for a new class.
setSubjectCode: Form label: a short unique code of a subject, for example MATH.
setNoSubjects: Empty state of the subjects list.
setNewYear: Button that opens the form for a new academic year.
setYearName: Hint for the name of an academic year.
setMakeActive: Button that makes an academic year the active one.
setConfirmActivate: Question before an academic year becomes the active one.
setYearAdded: Confirmation after adding an academic year.
setProfileTitle: Heading of the school profile form.
setBrandColour: Form label: the school's main colour.
setBrandHint: Hint under the brand colour field.
setProfileSaved: Confirmation after saving the school profile.
setImport: Button that opens the CSV import.
setCheckFile: Button that checks a CSV file without saving anything.
setCheckResult: Result of checking a CSV file.
setMissingColumns: Lists the columns a CSV file must have and does not.
setProblemLine: One problem found in a CSV file.
setAlreadyImported: Shown when the same CSV file is chosen again.
setImportNow: Button that imports a checked CSV file.
setImportFailed: Result after a CSV import when some rows failed.
hrrByDepartment: Heading of the payroll totals split by department.
hrrNoDepartment: Label for staff who have no department.
hrrNoRunsTitle: Empty state of the payroll summary.
webApplicationsWaiting: Dashboard number: admission applications that have come in and nobody has started to review.
webRunsWaiting: Dashboard number: draft pay runs the Principal has not approved yet.
webFieldRoleTitle: Heading shown on the web ERP to a person whose role is for the mobile apps (teacher, staff, driver, parent).
webFieldRoleBody: Explains where a mobile-app role should go. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
usrTabMembers: Tab: the people who can sign in to this school.
usrTabInvitations: Tab: the invitations that have been made.
usrSince: Column heading: when a person joined the school.
usrYou: Marks the row that is the signed-in person.
usrChangeRole: Button that changes the role of a member.
usrRole: Column heading and form label: the role a person has.
usrConfirmRole: Question before a member's role is changed.
usrConfirmSuspend: Question before a member is suspended.
usrConfirmRemove: Question before a member is removed.
usrNewAccount: Button that opens the form that creates an account for a staff member.
usrAccountIntro: Explains who an account is for.
usrLinkSent: Shown after the set-password email was sent.
usrLinkFailed: Shown when the set-password email could not be sent.
usrSendLink: Button that sends the set-password email again.
usrNewInvitation: Button that opens the form for an invitation.
usrExpiresIn: Form label: how many days an invitation can be used.
usrInvitationCode: Shown with a new invitation's secret code.
usrRevoke: Button that cancels an invitation that has not been used.
usrExpires: Column heading: when an invitation stops working.
usrPending: Status of an invitation nobody has used yet.
usrCancelled: Status of an invitation that was cancelled.
usrNoInvitations: Empty state of the invitations list.
usrHaveCode: Opens the box where a person enters the invitation code they were given.
usrEnterCode: Label of the invitation code field.
usrJoin: Button that uses an invitation code.
usrJoined: Confirmation after a person used an invitation code.
errorInvitationInvalid: Error: an invitation code was refused.
errorEmailNotVerified: Error: the person has not verified their email address.
errorOwnMembership: Error: someone tried to change their own role.
mobSchoolChoiceTitle: Title of the screen where a person with accounts at several schools picks one.
mobSchoolChoiceBody: Explains why the school list appears.
mobNoAccessTitle: Shown when sign-in worked but the person has no school with a role this app is for (for example a driver in the teacher app).
mobOpening: Shown briefly while the app restores a saved sign-in.
mobLockTitle: Title of the screen shown when the optional app lock asks the person to confirm.
mobLockBody: Explains the lock screen. The person uses the phone's own fingerprint, face or screen lock.
mobActionUnlock: Button on the lock screen; asks the phone to check the person.
mobUnlockFailed: Shown after the phone's check failed or was cancelled.
mobSignOutTitle: Title of the confirmation before signing out.
mobSignOutBody: Explains that signing out deletes the local data.
mobSignOutOwed: Warning in the sign-out confirmation when the phone still owes the server some changes. {count} is that number.
mobActionStaySignedIn: Safe choice in the sign-out confirmation.
mobActionSignOutAnyway: Destructive choice in the sign-out confirmation when changes would be lost.
mobAppLockTitle: Setting label for the optional app lock.
mobAppLockBody: Explains when the app lock asks again.
mobAppLockUnavailable: Shown when the app lock cannot be switched on because the phone has no lock.
mobSignedInAs: Shows who is signed in. {name} is the person's name or email.
mobSchoolRole: Role and school of the open session. {role} is a role name, {school} a school name.
mobHomeSoonTitle: Placeholder on the first home screen until the feature screens ship.
mobHomeSoonBody: Placeholder text; replaced when the feature screens ship.
mobCodeSentTo: Shown after a one-time code was requested. {phone} is the number.
mobActionChangeNumber: Goes back from the code box to the number box.
ntCatannouncement: Name of the notification category switch for announcements from the school.
notifAnnouncementPostedTitle: Title of the notice sent to staff when the Principal or the Academic administrator posts an announcement.
notifAnnouncementPostedBody: Body of that notice: the announcement's own title, written by its author in their language.
mobTodayTitle: Title of the Teacher app's first screen: what the teacher has to do today.
mobAccountLink: Link at the top of the home screen that opens the person's account, the app lock switch and sign out.
mobTodayNextLessons: Heading of the list of the teacher's remaining lessons today.
mobTodayNoMoreLessons: Shown when the teacher has no lessons left today.
mobTodayNotSchoolDay: Shown on a day the school does not work, such as a Sunday.
mobTodayLessonLine: One lesson in the list: the class, and when it starts and ends. {className} is a class name; {start} and {end} are times.
mobTodayAttendanceTitle: Heading of the card about taking student attendance today.
mobTodayAttendanceMissing: How many of the teacher's classes still have no attendance today. {count} is the number.
mobTodayAttendanceAllDone: Shown when every class of the teacher has its attendance today.
mobTodayAttendanceSaved: How many classes have attendance saved on the phone that has not reached the school yet. {count} is the number.
mobTodayLeaveTitle: Heading of the card about the teacher's own leave requests.
mobTodayLeaveWaiting: How many of the teacher's leave requests the Principal has not decided yet. {count} is the number.
mobTodayLeaveNone: Shown when the teacher has no leave request waiting for a decision.
mobTodayLeaveSaved: How many leave requests are saved on the phone and have not reached the school yet. {count} is the number.
mobTodayFirstLoad: Shown on the first day, before any data has been loaded from the school.
actionBack: Button that goes back to the previous screen.
mobTabAttendance: Name of the Attendance tab in the Teacher app's bottom navigation.
mobTabMore: Name of the tab with the account, the app lock and sign out.
mobAttClassesTitle: Heading of the list of classes the teacher takes attendance for.
mobAttNoClasses: Shown when the teacher is not class teacher of any class.
mobAttStateDone: State of a class today: attendance has been taken and the school has it.
mobAttStateSaved: State of a class today: attendance is saved on the phone and not yet sent.
mobAttStateTodo: State of a class today: no attendance yet.
mobAttStateLocked: State of a class today: the day is locked and only the Academic administrator can change it.
mobAttStateFailed: State of a class today: the school refused the attendance sent from this phone.
mobAttMarkAllPresent: Button that sets every student to present before the teacher marks the exceptions.
mobAttSave: Primary button of the attendance screen. It saves on the phone at once and sends when there is a connection.
mobAttSavedNotSent: Banner shown after saving attendance that has not reached the school yet.
mobAttLocked: Banner on a day that is locked.
mobAttRefused: Banner when the school refused attendance sent from the phone.
mobAttRefusedLocked: Explains a refusal because the day was locked.
actionDismiss: Button that removes a message the person has read.
mobAttExceptions: How many students are marked as something other than present. {count} is the number.
mobAttEveryonePresent: Shown when no student is marked as an exception.
mobAttPickStatus: Title of the list of statuses for one student. {name} is the student.
mobAttNoStudents: Shown when a class has no students.
mobAttNotLoaded: Shown when the class list has not been loaded onto the phone yet.
mobAttDateLine: Title of the attendance screen: the class and the date. {className} is the class name, {date} the date.
mobTabMarks: Name of the Marks tab in the Teacher app's bottom navigation.
mobMarksExamsTitle: Heading of the list of exams the teacher can enter marks for.
mobMarksNoExams: Shown when the teacher has no exam to enter marks for.
mobMarksExamLine: Second line of an exam in the list: the class and the subject. {className} is the class name, {subject} the subject.
mobMarksOutOf: How many marks an exam is out of. {max} is the number.
mobMarksProgress: How many students have marks entered. {done} and {total} are numbers.
mobMarksAbsent: Switch next to a student's marks: the student did not sit the exam.
mobMarksFieldLabel: Spoken label of the marks box of one student. {name} is the student.
mobMarksErrAbove: Error under a marks box when the number is above the exam's maximum. {max} is the maximum.
mobMarksErrFormat: Error under a marks box when the text is not a number with at most one decimal.
mobMarksSave: Primary button of the marks screen. It saves on the phone at once and sends when there is a connection.
mobMarksRefused: Banner when the school refused marks sent from the phone.
mobMarksRefusedAbove: Explains a refusal because a mark was above the exam's maximum.
mobMarksRefusedChanged: Explains a refusal because the exam or the class changed after the marks were typed.
mobMarksNotLoaded: Shown when the exam's student list has not been loaded onto the phone yet.
mobMarksNoStudents: Shown when the exam's class has no students.
mobMarksErrors: Shown above the list when some marks are not valid yet and so cannot be saved. {count} is the number.
mobTabLeave: Name of the Leave tab in the Teacher app's bottom navigation.
mobLvBalances: Heading of the card showing how much leave of each type the teacher has left.
mobLvBalanceLine: One type of leave and how much is left. {type} is the leave type, {remaining} and {allowed} are numbers of days.
mobLvBalanceUnset: A type of leave that has no allowance set. {type} is the leave type.
mobLvRequests: Heading of the list of the teacher's own leave requests.
mobLvNone: Shown when the teacher has no leave requests.
mobLvAsk: Button that opens the leave request form.
mobLvStatusPending: Status of a leave request that has not been decided.
mobLvStatusApproved: Status of a leave request the Principal approved.
mobLvStatusRejected: Status of a leave request the Principal did not approve.
mobLvStatusCancelled: Status of a leave request that was cancelled.
mobLvSavedNotSent: Status of a leave request that is waiting on the phone for a connection.
mobLvRefused: Banner when the school refused a leave request sent from the phone.
mobLvRefusedConflict: Explains a refusal of a leave request: it overlaps another one, or the allowance is used up.
mobLvDays: How long a leave request is. {days} is a number such as 1 or 1.5.
mobLvDates: The dates of a leave request. {start} and {end} are dates.
mobLvFormTitle: Title of the leave request form.
mobLvType: Label of the leave type choice.
mobLvStart: Label of the first day of leave.
mobLvEnd: Label of the last day of leave.
mobLvHalf: Switch for asking for half a day of leave.
mobLvMorning: Choice for a half day of leave: the morning.
mobLvAfternoon: Choice for a half day of leave: the afternoon.
mobLvReason: Label of the optional reason for a leave request.
mobLvSend: Primary button of the leave form. It saves on the phone at once and sends when there is a connection.
mobLvErrEnd: Error when the leave dates are the wrong way round.
mobLvErrType: Error when no leave type was chosen.
mobLvNoTypes: Shown in the leave form before the leave types have been loaded onto the phone.
mobMoreCover: Name of the list of lessons the teacher covers for colleagues on leave.
mobCoverEmpty: Shown when the teacher has no cover duty coming up.
mobCoverLine: One cover duty: the class, the subject and the period. {className}, {subject} and {period} are names.
mobCoverFor: Who the teacher covers for. {name} is the colleague.
mobMoreClasses: Name of the list of classes the teacher teaches.
mobClsEmpty: Shown when the teacher has no class.
mobClsStudents: How many students a class has. {count} is the number.
mobClsReport: Title of a student's report card.
mobClsTerm: Label of the term choice on a report card.
mobClsNoCard: Shown when a report card has not been loaded and the phone has no connection.
mobClsMarksLine: A subject's marks on a report card. {marks} and {max} are marks.
mobClsTotal: The total on a report card. {marks} is the total marks, {percent} the percentage.
mobClsGrade: The grade on a report card. {grade} is the grade.
mobClsPending: How many exams of a report card have no marks yet. {count} is the number.
mobTabHome: Name of the Home tab in the Staff app's bottom navigation.
mobAnnEmpty: Shown when the school has posted no announcement.
mobAnnBy: Who posted an announcement. {name} is the person.
mobAnnLatest: Heading of the card on Home that shows the newest announcements.
mobTabApprovals: Name of the Principal's tab in the Staff app where leave requests are decided.
mobApprEmpty: Shown to the Principal when no leave request is waiting for a decision.
mobApprApprove: Button that approves a leave request.
mobApprReject: Button that turns down a leave request.
mobApprLine: One leave request waiting for a decision. {name} is the staff member and {type} the kind of leave.
mobApprNeedsNet: Shown when the Principal tried to approve or turn down leave with no connection.
mobApprRefused: Shown when the school refused the Principal's decision on a leave request.
mobCiNotIn: Shown when the person has not checked in at work today.
mobCiIn: When the person checked in. {time} is a time of day.
mobCiOut: When the person checked out. {time} is a time of day.
mobCiSavedIn: A check-in waiting on the phone for a connection.
mobCiSavedOut: A check-out waiting on the phone for a connection.
mobCiCheckIn: Button that records that the person has arrived at work.
mobCiCheckOut: Button that records that the person is leaving work.
mobCiLocating: Shown for a few seconds while the phone finds where it is.
mobCiReasonTitle: Title of the box that asks for a reason when the person is not at the school.
mobCiReasonOutside: Explains why a reason is asked. {distance} is a number of metres.
mobCiReasonNoPosition: Explains why a reason is asked when the phone had no position.
mobCiReasonFar: Warns that a check-in far from the school waits for HR to confirm it.
mobCiReasonSend: Button that records the check-in or check-out with the reason.
mobCiReasonEmpty: Error when the reason box is empty.
mobCiWaitingHr: Shown beside a check-in made far from the school that HR has not confirmed yet.
mobCiRefused: Banner when the school refused a check-in or check-out sent from the phone.
mobMoreAnnouncements: Row in the More tab that opens the list of announcements.
mobMoreInbox: Row in the More tab that opens the list of notifications.
mobInboxEmpty: Shown when the person has no notifications.
mobInboxUnread: How many notifications have not been read. {count} is a number.
satPosition: Column in the staff attendance table: where the check-in happened (at school, away, unknown).
satStampINSIDE: The check-in was made inside the school's area.
satStampOUTSIDE: The check-in was made outside the school's area.
satStampUNKNOWN: The phone sent no position, or the school has set no area.
satDistance: How far from the school a check-in was made. {metres} is a number.
satReasonIs: The reason a person gave for a check-in away from the school. {reason} is what they wrote.
satWaiting: A check-in far from the school that HR has not confirmed yet.
satConfirm: Button with which HR confirms a check-in made far from the school.
satConfirmedAt: A check-in far from the school that HR has confirmed.
satConfirmedOk: Shown after HR confirmed a check-in.
setGeoTitle: Title of the settings card where the school's point on the map is set.
setGeoNote: Explains what the school location does.
setGeoLat: Field: the school's latitude in degrees, for example 12.9716.
setGeoLng: Field: the school's longitude in degrees, for example 77.5946.
setGeoRadius: Field: how far from the point the school's grounds reach, in metres.
setGeoMargin: Field: extra metres around the grounds in which nobody is asked for a reason.
setGeoSave: Button that saves the school location.
setGeoClear: Button that switches the school location off.
setGeoSaved: Shown after the school location was saved.
setGeoCleared: Shown after the school location was switched off.
setGeoNow: The school location as it is now.
setGeoNone: Shown when the school has no location set.
setGeoInvalid: Error when the school location values are not valid.
annNone: Shown when no announcement has been posted.
annPostTitle: Title of the card where an announcement is written.
annPosted: Shown after an announcement was posted.
annWithdraw: Button that withdraws an announcement so nobody sees it any more.
annWithdrawn: Tag on an announcement that was withdrawn.
annWithdrawnOk: Shown after an announcement was withdrawn.
annFrom: Who posted an announcement and when. {name} is the person, {date} the day.
mobCiCardTitle: Title of the card that shows whether the person has checked in at work today.
mobCiOpen: Link that opens the screen where the person checks in and out of work.
trnViewLabel: Label of the choice between the vehicles list and the routes list on the Transport screen.
trnTabVehicles: Tab: the list of the school's vehicles.
trnTabRoutes: Tab: the list of bus routes.
trnAdd: Button that adds a vehicle, a route or a stop.
trnDelete: Button that deletes a vehicle or a route.
trnRemove: Button that removes a stop or a rider from a list.
trnPrint: Button that prints the list of who rides a route.
trnNoVehicles: Shown when the school has no vehicle on the list.
trnNoRoutes: Shown when the school has no bus route.
trnVehicleName: Field: what the school calls the vehicle.
trnSeats: Field and column: how many seats a vehicle has.
trnStatusACTIVE: Status of a vehicle that is in use.
trnStatusOUT_OF_SERVICE: Status of a vehicle that is not in use.
trnPlateInUse: Error when a vehicle with that number plate already exists.
trnVehicleInUse: Error when deleting a vehicle that a route uses.
trnRouteName: Field: the name of a bus route.
trnDirection: Field: whether the route runs to the school or home.
trnMORNING: Direction of a route that takes students to the school.
trnAFTERNOON: Direction of a route that takes students home.
trnStartsAt: Field: the time a route starts, for example 07:15.
trnVehicle: Field and column: the vehicle that runs a route.
trnDriver: Field and column: the driver of a route.
trnNoneChosen: Choice meaning no vehicle or no driver.
trnRouteNameInUse: Error when a route name is taken.
trnNotADriver: Error when the chosen driver does not hold the driver role.
trnStops: Heading: the stops of a route in the order the bus calls.
trnStopName: Field: the name of a stop.
trnStopTime: Field: the planned time at a stop, for example 07:30.
trnMoveUp: Button that moves a stop earlier in the order.
trnMoveDown: Button that moves a stop later in the order.
trnSaveStops: Button that saves the list of stops.
trnStopsSaved: Shown after the stops were saved.
trnStopsDropped: Shown after saving the stops when some students lost their seat. {count} is a number.
trnDuplicateStop: Error when two stops of a route share a name.
trnSeatTitle: Heading of the card where a student is put on this route.
trnFindStudent: Field: search for a student by name or enrolment number.
trnFindHint: Hint under the student search field.
trnChooseStop: Field: the stop where the student gets on.
trnSeat: Button that seats the chosen student on this route and stop.
trnSeated: Shown after a student was seated.
trnUnseated: Shown after a student's seat was removed.
trnVehicleFull: Error when the route's vehicle is full.
trnStudentNotFound: Error when the chosen student is not an active student of this school.
trnWhoRides: Heading: the list of students on a route, stop by stop.
trnNobodyAtStop: Shown under a stop that has no student.
trnSeatsTaken: How many of the vehicle's seats are taken. {assigned} and {capacity} are numbers.
trnRiding: How many students ride a route that has no vehicle yet. {assigned} is a number.
ntCatstudentleave: Name of the category of notifications about a student's leave.
notifStudentleaveRequestedTitle: Title of the notification a class teacher gets when a parent asks leave for a student.
notifStudentleaveRequestedBody: Body of that notification. {studentName} is the student, {startDate} and {endDate} are dates, {reason} what the parent wrote.
notifStudentleaveApprovedTitle: Title of the notification a parent gets when their child's leave was approved.
notifStudentleaveApprovedBody: Body of that notification. {studentName} is the student, {startDate} and {endDate} are dates.
notifStudentleaveDeclinedTitle: Title of the notification a parent gets when their child's leave was not approved.
notifStudentleaveDeclinedBody: Body of that notification. {studentName} is the student, {startDate} and {endDate} are dates, {note} the reason the school gave.
